title: Record Actions & Lifecycle States
codex_guardrail: Use as a reusable lifecycle-action pattern. Draft may be deletable when unreferenced; active/archived/finalized/immutable states require domain-specific safeguards. Finalized/immutable records use correction/reversal rather than destructive edit.
authority_note: Stitch is a visual/reference source. ErgonX backend/domain invariants, tenant isolation, RBAC, module gating, audit and lifecycle rules are authoritative.
